rca of the issue: Bug (reported): report used naive UTC datetimes and over-counted replies. Root cause of over-count: each reply row was joined multi-to-multi with all send rows in the same window, so N sends × 1 reply produced N 'replied' flags. Root cause of UTC times: created_at rendered via strftime without tz conversion. Fix in monthly_report.py now (a) fetches parent.timezone (Asia/Kolkata) and converts each timestamp with astimezone(tz) before formatting/grouping, and (b) consumes each reply once (attributes at most one reply per send). API response now shows reply_rate 0.444 and IST times — verified live.
